definition: Way of the Future (WOTF) is the first known religious organization dedicated to the worship of artificial intelligence (AI).
details: It was founded in 2017 by American engineer Anthony Levandowski.

explainer.lead: Way of the Future (WOTF) is the first known religious organization dedicated to the worship of artificial intelligence. It matters as a cultural marker of AI's growing social significance.

tiers.eli5: It is like a church, except the thing people gather around is a computer program rather than a god.
tiers.practitioner: Not an engineering tool; it is a cultural and organizational artifact, founded in 2017 by American engineer Anthony Levandowski.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined as the first known religious organization dedicated to the worship of artificial intelligence, founded in 2017 by Anthony Levandowski.

explainer.example: An engineer founded the organization in 2017 to worship AI, making it the first known religious group of its kind.
